verdict.rationale: Convex's own GitHub repo documents a telemetry opt-out for the self-hosted backend: the `--disable-beacon` flag on the backend binary. That flag only covers self-hosted deployments, and the wording ("if you really want to disable it") suggests the beacon is on by default and opt-out is discouraged. missing for 10: telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out for the hosted cloud service, opt-out for CLI/dashboard telemetry, documentation of what data is collected, an environment-variable or config-based opt-out for Docker users, and independent corroboration.
